title: The 2026 Small-Business Streaming TV Advertising Benchmark

facts.fact: Trusted TV reports that most small businesses run about $25 per day on its platform.
Trusted TV reports that the typical daily budget is $25/day, roughly $700 over a four-week cycle, with the video and campaign management included.
facts.quote: The typical daily budget is **$25/day**, roughly $700 over a four-week cycle.

facts.fact: Trusted TV reports that a typical four-week campaign earns roughly 9,100 views.
facts.quote: A typical four-week campaign earns roughly 9,100 views and reaches about 5,900 people.

facts.fact: Trusted TV reports that a typical four-week campaign reaches about 5,900 people.
facts.quote: A typical four-week campaign earns roughly 9,100 views and reaches about 5,900 people.

facts.fact: Trusted TV reports that its all-in CPM across all campaigns averages about $42.50 per 1,000 views, including the AI-made video and ongoing management.
facts.quote: that averages about **$42.50** across all campaigns.

facts.fact: Trusted TV reports that roughly 100% of its campaigns set their own geography, and the most common targeting is a 10-mile radius around a ZIP code.
facts.quote: roughly 100% of campaigns set their own geography

facts.fact: Trusted TV reports that the most common targeting setting for its campaigns is a 10-mile radius around a ZIP code.
facts.quote: the most common setting is a 10-mile radius around a ZIP code

facts.fact: Trusted TV reports that its ads reached 18,310 distinct ZIP codes across all 50 states in aggregate.
facts.quote: Trusted TV ads reached **18,310 distinct ZIP codes across all 50 states**.

facts.fact: Trusted TV reports that the median business goes from signup to a live campaign in about 41 minutes.
facts.quote: the **median business goes from signup to a live campaign in about 41 minutes**

facts.fact: Trusted TV reports that among businesses with firmographic data, 61% have 10 or fewer employees.
